video: 60-second vertical explainer that shows beginners how GROUP BY and SUM turn a table of store sales into one total per store, and how HAVING tests those totals

camera_move.what: The camera pans and zooms smoothly to the part of the picture being explained, then back out to show everything

camera_breathing.what: The whole picture slowly and very slightly zooms in and out in a continuous loop, so held frames do not look frozen

headline_reveal.what: Each headline line slides up into view from behind a mask

headline_exit.what: The headline fades out just before the next scene

subtitle_bar_fade.what: The subtitle bar fades in when a spoken line starts and fades out when it ends

subtitle_word_reveal.what: Subtitle words brighten in groups of three as they are spoken

card_outline_draw.what: The outline of a table or card draws itself, then the card fills in

table_rows_wipe.what: Each row of a table is revealed from left to right, one row after another

chip_wipe.what: A small label chip is revealed from left to right

query_typing.what: One line of the query is typed letter by letter

world_exit.what: The tables and the query card fade away to make room for the logo

logo_bars_grow.what: The four logo bars grow upward one after another from left to right

wordmark_reveal.what: The DataEntropy wordmark is revealed from left to right

logo_glow.what: A soft violet glow brightens around the logo bars and settles

tagline_enter.what: The tagline is revealed from left to right under the wordmark

cta_arrow_nudge.what: The arrow in the button nudges to the right once

question_mark_enter.what: A large violet question mark fades in beside the sales table

hand_band_enter.what: A highlight band fades in over one row of the table

hand_band_hop.what: The highlight band slides down to the next row of the same store

hand_sum_count.what: The running total in a chip beside the table counts up as each row is added

row_counter_count.what: The number of rows in a chip above the table counts upward steadily from eight to one million

by_hand_exit.what: The highlight band, the running total and the row counter fade away

tray_label_enter.what: The store name fades in inside its tray

row_chip_enter.what: A small white chip fades in over a row's amount in the table

row_chip_travel.what: The chip with a row's amount travels in a shallow arc from the table into the tray of its store

amount_join_total.what: An amount chip in a tray turns pale as its value is added

total_bar_grow.what: The violet bar in a tray grows longer and the number at its end counts up as each amount is added

total_enter.what: The total number fades in at the end of a tray's bar

tray_parts_exit.what: The amount chips and the bar fade out of each tray

tray_fold.what: Each tray shrinks into one row and the three rows stack into a table, with the store name and its total sliding into place

tray_outline_exit.what: The navy outlines of the three trays fade as the result table's violet outline takes over

best_outline_draw.what: A violet outline draws itself around the row with the largest total

best_total_light.what: The largest total turns from navy to violet

best_outline_exit.what: The outline around the largest total fades away

test_band_enter.what: A violet outlined band fades in over the first row of the result table

test_band_step.what: The violet band slides down from one result row to the next

test_band_exit.what: The violet band fades away after the last row

check_draw.what: A violet check mark draws itself beside a total that passes the test

group_dim.what: The row of the store that fails the test fades from navy to pale gray

where_link_draw.what: A violet arrow draws itself from the label 'WHERE tests rows' to the sales table

where_link_exit.what: The arrow to the sales table fades away

summary_arrow_draw.what: A violet arrow draws itself from the sales table to the result table
